name: T-Therapeutics
what: Clinical-stage biotech building TCR-CD3 bispecific T-cell engagers using its OpTiMus platform to generate fully human TCRs. Lead programmes TTX-008 (oncology) and TTX-018 (immunology). Backed by Eli Lilly, JJDC, Sanofi Ventures and Tencent.
investors: Advent Life Sciences, British Business Bank, JJDC, Samsara BioCapital, M Ventures, Eli Lilly, Sofinnova, F-Prime, Sanofi Ventures, Tencent
source_note: new financing brings T-Therapeutics' disclosed funding to about $224 million

name: Bionyra Pharma
what: Biotech developing next-generation antibody biologics for immune-mediated inflammatory diseases such as IBD and atopic dermatitis; two assets in phase 1 for IBD and one at IND stage. Launched with France's largest ever biotech Series A.
investors: Sofinnova Partners, Jeito Capital, Arkin Bio, Sanofi Ventures, Sixty Degree Capital, Vives Partners, Apollo Health Ventures
source_note: $165 million (about EUR 143 million) Series A, 22 June 2026

name: Loom Games
what: Turkish mobile game studio behind hybrid-casual title Pixel Flow. Scopely agreed a multi-year, performance-based deal for a majority stake in 2026, valuing the business above USD 1B after a seed round valued it at USD 36M.
source_note: Valuation: over $1 billion, per the article (article dated May 14, 2026); exact financials not disclosed
